title: Binomial replication and risk-neutral valuation
objectives: Derive the strict no-arbitrage interval and replicate every two-state payoff
Interpret pricing probabilities without imposing risk-neutral investor preferences
Verify dynamic self-financing and exercise-date backward induction
Identify failure of uniqueness and recombination when spanning or state sufficiency fails
prerequisites: Option payoffs and exercise styles; financing conventions; elementary linear algebra and conditional expectation.
source_scope: Full sequential reading of official English captions at positions 44–45; source put independently recomputed. No comprehensive audiovisual audit. Risk-neutral-preference rhetoric, interior-strike restriction, and coarse exercise-grid limitations are corrected explicitly.
